GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Steadied from heels near the 1300m. Raced keenly in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn 2 Lengths rail, Held Up home turn and mostly blocked until the 75m # no luck in Straight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Inclined to lay out throughout e&m stages. Shortly after straightening was steadied inwards after laying out towards heels of another runner. Unable to be fully tested from this point down the straight as rider persisted for narrow run and mount continued to lay out towards heels of another runner. Close to finish line was again steadied in away from heels of another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Laid out round home turn.
